hazards.title: Rapid Gully Expansion at Uwelu Spare Parts Market
hazards.hazard_type: Headward gully migration and foundation undermining
hazards.description: Severe gully erosion triggered by diverted municipal stormwater. The gully head is within 4 meters of 40 active commercial shops and high-tension electrical transmission line.
hazards.address_description: Off Textile Mill Road, behind Uwelu Motor Spare Parts Market, Benin City.
hazards.estimated_affected_assets: 42 commercial shop blocks, 1 public health center, 3 electrical transmission towers, 1 asphalt access road.
hazards.potential_impact: Catastrophic collapse of commercial market stalls, loss of livelihoods, severance of power grid to 5 communities, potential casualties during flash storms.
hazards.verification_notes: Verified in person by Technical Officer Chinwe Okoro on Aug 16, 2026. Slope failure is active. Urgent intervention required before September peak rainfall.

assessment.environmental_impact: Topsoil removal, sediment choking downstream Ikpoba watershed, groundwater contamination.
assessment.economic_impact: Over ₦450 Million in direct commercial merchandise and infrastructure assets at immediate risk.
assessment.social_impact: Threat to market traders, displacement of 28 residential households adjoining the ravine rim.
assessment.technical_findings: Subsurface piping in friable Benin formation sand. Lack of hydraulic energy dissipation at stormwater outlet is causing scouring velocity of >4.5 m/s.

recommended_intervention.title: Emergency Uwelu Gully Stabilization & Energy Dissipation Works
recommended_intervention.scope_description: Installation of 120m double-tiered gabion retaining walls, emergency sheet piling at gully head, rock rip-rap stilling basin, and diversion culvert.
recommended_intervention.expected_outcome: Halt headward gully migration, secure market perimeter, stabilize 14,500 sqm of threatened urban land.

hazards.title: Catastrophic Flash Flooding & Blocked Canal at Oredo LGA
hazards.hazard_type: Severe urban flooding and waterway obstruction
hazards.description: Massive accumulation of plastic refuse and silt obstructing the primary municipal drainage canal at Forestry / Sakponba junction. Water submerges roads by 1.2 meters after 30 minutes of rain.
hazards.address_description: Major arterial drainage canal crossing Sakponba Road toward Ogba River basin.
hazards.estimated_affected_assets: 120 commercial shops, 65 residential houses, 2 primary schools, major traffic artery.
hazards.potential_impact: Severe business disruption, flood damage to properties, outbreak of waterborne diseases (cholera/malaria), vehicular submergence.
hazards.verification_notes: Inspected by Monitoring Coordinator Arch. Olumide Johnson on Aug 21, 2026. Obstruction confirmed; water flow reduced by 85%.

assessment.environmental_impact: Stagnant wastewater, vector breeding, urban siltation.
assessment.economic_impact: Daily economic loss estimated at ₦35 Million in lost trade during rain episodes.
assessment.social_impact: School closures, pedestrian danger, contamination of shallow boreholes.
assessment.technical_findings: Over 1,200 metric tons of debris and sediment trapped under low-clearance slab bridge.

recommended_intervention.title: Emergency Mechanical Desilting and Trash Rack Installation at Forestry Canal
recommended_intervention.scope_description: Immediate deployment of amphibious excavators to clear 2.8km of blocked channel, installation of hydraulic debris interceptors, and raising bridge headwall.
recommended_intervention.expected_outcome: Restore 100% hydraulic discharge capacity, eliminate standing floodwaters in residential quarters.

hazards.title: Catastrophic Ravine & Gully Head Advance threatening Igbe Road & Residences
hazards.hazard_type: Deep ravine expansion and urban residential threat
hazards.description: Violent headward progression of 28m-deep gully following intensive rainstorm. The ravine rim has encroached within 6 meters of Igbe Road asphalt pavement and 14 multi-family homes in Auchi.
hazards.address_description: Igbe Road sector, south of Auchi Central Market, Auchi.
hazards.estimated_affected_assets: 14 residential buildings, Igbe Road municipal corridor, water pipeline right-of-way.
hazards.potential_impact: Structural collapse of residential compounds, total cutoff of Auchi secondary access road, severe sediment wash into Orle river.
hazards.verification_notes: Technical survey completed on Aug 28, 2026 by EDEFA rapid assessment team. Active head scarp retreating at 1.4m per month.

assessment.environmental_impact: Massive loss of arable topsoil, downstream siltation, damage to local vegetation.
assessment.economic_impact: Over ₦320 Million in direct housing assets and road infrastructure under immediate threat.
assessment.social_impact: Potential displacement of over 40 families, disruption of neighborhood access.
assessment.technical_findings: Uncontrolled storm runoff from hill slopes discharging into friable sand layer without drop structures.
assessment.recommended_intervention_type: Stepped Concrete Chute & Gabion Check Dams

hazards.title: Severe Slope Failure & Escarpment Ravine at Ujoelen-AAU Campus Corridor
hazards.hazard_type: Slope failure, road embankment slump, and deep gully fissure
hazards.description: Major slope instability along the hilly Ujoelen escarpment following heavy downpours. Lateral tension cracks 20cm wide have developed across the arterial road linking Ekpoma town to Ambrose Alli University.
hazards.address_description: Km 3 Ekpoma-Ujoelen Highway Corridor, Esan West LGA.
hazards.estimated_affected_assets: University access highway corridor, telecommunications optical fibre route, roadside faculty quarters.
hazards.potential_impact: Complete severance of university commuter transport, vehicular rollover accidents, destruction of high-voltage lines.
hazards.verification_notes: Urgent site visit confirmed lateral slip of upper embankment. Highway safety barricades and warning beacons erected.

assessment.environmental_impact: Mass soil movement, severe destabilization of escarpment vegetative mantle.
assessment.economic_impact: Transportation paralysis and costly emergency diversion for Ekpoma and AAU academic community.
assessment.social_impact: Severe student commuter distress, urgent public safety hazard.
assessment.technical_findings: Subsurface water accumulation over compacted clay substratum creating a frictionless shear failure plane.
assessment.recommended_intervention_type: Geotechnical Soil Nailing & Concrete Retaining Piles

hazards.title: Riverbank Degradation & Riparian Siltation along Gelegele Waterway
hazards.hazard_type: Riparian embankment scour and waterway shoaling
hazards.description: Severe riverbank scouring and soil slippage along the Gelegele riverfront corridor, threatening fish landing jetties and causing navigational channel silting.
hazards.address_description: Along Gelegele River waterfront, 18km southwest of Egor boundary.
hazards.estimated_affected_assets: Artisanal jetty, community cold-room station, primary school playground.
hazards.potential_impact: Loss of waterfront infrastructure, silting of river transport channel, flood inundation during high tide.

hazards.title: Solid Waste Dumping and Drainage Choking at Ibillo Commercial Center
hazards.hazard_type: Massive solid waste blockage in inter-community storm collector
hazards.description: Unauthorized accumulation of market scrap and refuse filling 400m of masonry drainage channel along the Ibillo-Okene transit corridor, causing foul backwater flooding during storms.
hazards.address_description: Adjacent to Ibillo Central Market culvert, Akoko Edo LGA.
hazards.estimated_affected_assets: Market access roadway, 35 trading stalls, shallow drinking wells.
hazards.potential_impact: Groundwater contamination, vector breeding, recurring market flood inundation.

projects.title: Queen Ede Gully Erosion & Flood Control Intervention Project
projects.description: Comprehensive stabilization, concrete chute installation, bio-remediation and gully head protection at Queen Ede Catholic Church corridor, Benin City.
projects.funding_source: Edo State Ecological Fund Direct Allocation
projects.contractor: Julius Berger Nig. Plc / Hydro-Geo Consortium

milestones.title: Phase 1: Site clearing and stormwater diversion
Phase 2: Stepped spillway and retaining wall concrete works
Phase 3: Backfilling, compaction and vetiver turfing
Phase 4: Road reinstatement and drainage link to Ikpoba River

projects.remarks: Work slowed down slightly in July due to intense flash flooding; emergency pumps mobilized.

projects.title: Auchi Oshiobugie Gully Erosion & Watershed Reclamation Project
projects.description: Stabilization of catastrophic gully erosion advancing toward Federal Polytechnic Auchi, concrete stepped chutes, check dams, and vetiver grass biological slope stabilization.
projects.funding_source: Edo State Ecological Project Fund / Strategic Priority Envelope
projects.contractor: CGC Nigeria Limited / Edo Geo-Eng Consortium

milestones.title: Geotechnical anchors and retaining pile installation
Construction of 2.4km main outfall drainage canal to Orle River
Terracing of steep slopes and agro-forestry planting

projects.remarks: Progress on schedule; local community taskforce active in monitoring site.

projects.title: Gapiona-Amagba Stormwater Drainage & Flood Deflection Channelization
projects.description: Dual-cell stormwater retention basin, reinforced concrete outfall canal toward Ogba River, and road culvert protection across Gapiona-Ugbor-Amagba watershed.
projects.funding_source: Edo State Ecological Fund Strategic Priority Envelope

milestones.title: Excavation and concrete lining of 3.2km main deflection canal
Dual retention pond and silt trap construction
Final inspection & ecological handover to Edo Ministry of Environment

projects.remarks: Project successfully completed and handed over. Zero residential flooding recorded during recent heavy downpours.

sites.name: Queen Ede Chute & Retention Section A
sites.terrain_type: Steep Gully Slope with Red Laterite Soil
sites.baseline_condition: Severely degraded 35-meter deep gully ravine threatening 140 residential houses.

sites.name: Upper Mission Stormwater Discharge Culvert
sites.baseline_condition: Collapsed triple cell box culvert causing severe road washout and ponding.

sites.name: Auchi Oshiobugie Canyon Inflow Sector
sites.terrain_type: Deep Sedimentary Gully Bed with Sandstone Substratum
sites.baseline_condition: Active headward migration advancing at 8 meters per rainy season toward polytechnic.

sites.name: Gapiona-Amagba Stormwater Discharge Outfall
sites.baseline_condition: High floodwaters overflowing into residential estates prior to concrete channelization.

site_visits.purpose: Baseline inspection and verification of site possession by contractor.
site_visits.activities_observed: Survey team pegging alignment; earth excavators mobilizing to upper ravine head.
site_visits.work_completed: Preliminary site clearing and establishment of site camp.
site_visits.work_outstanding: Retaining walls, stepped chute, diversion channel.
site_visits.materials_equipment: 2 CAT 330 excavators, 1 bulldozer, reinforcing steel bundles on site.
site_visits.quality_observations: Contractor requested to test soil bearing capacity before concrete footing pour.
site_visits.safety_observations: Warning tape needed around the 30m gully crest to protect community children.
site_visits.problems_challenges: Encroaching residential kiosks must be relocated 15m away from rim.
site_visits.recommendations: State Ministry of Lands should expedite compensation to 4 temporary kiosk owners.
site_visits.officer_comments: Project started with high community cooperation.

site_visits.purpose: Mid-term milestone evaluation of reinforced concrete stepped spillway.
site_visits.activities_observed: Pouring of concrete steps 12 through 18; steel reinforcement tying.
site_visits.work_completed: Foundation footings, retaining wingwalls on eastern flank, drainage sub-base.
site_visits.work_outstanding: Western wingwall, gabion mattress energy dissipators, grass turfing.
site_visits.materials_equipment: Concrete batching plant operational; 4 mixer trucks active.
site_visits.quality_observations: Cylinder compressive strength tests yielded 28 MPa at 28 days (exceeds 25 MPa spec).
site_visits.safety_observations: All workers observed wearing safety helmets, boots, and reflective vests.
site_visits.problems_challenges: Dust suppression needed on access haul road.
site_visits.recommendations: Water bowser should sprinkle road twice daily.

site_visits.purpose: Rainy season resilience assessment and progress check on gabion energy dissipators.
site_visits.weather_conditions: Torrential rains preceding day; active runoff in channel.
site_visits.activities_observed: Channel successfully conveyed 45,000 m3 of storm runoff without overtopping or scour.
site_visits.work_completed: Chute structure 90% complete; gabion mattresses in stilling basin underway.
site_visits.work_outstanding: Slope vegetative turfing and peripheral collector drains.
site_visits.materials_equipment: Heavy rock rip-rap delivery trucks, compaction rollers.
site_visits.quality_observations: Spillway baffle blocks successfully dissipated kinetic energy of torrential water.
site_visits.safety_observations: Safety signage intact; perimeter fence erected.
site_visits.problems_challenges: Minor silt accumulation in lower stilling basin requiring mechanical clearing.
site_visits.recommendations: Clean out silt trap before peak September rains.
site_visits.officer_comments: The intervention is already protecting the community from further collapse.

evidence_files.description: Gully crest showing 35-meter sheer vertical drop and active soil tension cracks near market building foundation.
Collapsed stormwater culvert discharging uncontrolled high-velocity runoff directly onto unarmored red sand slope.
Aerial drone video reconnaissance showing gully head advancing toward 330kV transmission pylon and Uwelu market.
Forestry canal choked with non-biodegradable plastics and urban sediment, causing backwater flooding.
Initial site condition prior to civil works: catastrophic gully threatening Queen Ede Secondary School.
Construction of reinforced concrete stepped spillway in progress; wingwalls taking shape.
Current monitoring state: Concrete chute successfully conveying peak monsoon torrents with zero bank collapse.

interventions.title: Emergency Uwelu Gully Stabilization & Energy Dissipation Works
interventions.technical_description: Engineering deployment: 120m double-tiered gabion retaining walls with rock rip-rap stilling basin, step chutes and stormwater diversion pipe to prevent collapse of Uwelu market.
interventions.estimated_scope: 14,500 sqm stabilization; 120 linear meters of 6m-high gabion wall.
interventions.expected_outcome: Arrest gully head retreat, protect 42 market buildings and transmission tower.

interventions.title: Emergency Mechanical Desilting and Trash Rack Installation at Forestry Canal
interventions.technical_description: Heavy hydraulic dredging and desilting of 2.8km stormwater canal, removal of 1,200 metric tons of debris, fabrication of heavy galvanized trash racks.
interventions.estimated_scope: 2.8 km canal clearance, 3 trash rack stations, 1 silt collector basin.
interventions.expected_outcome: Eliminate flood ponding on Sakponba Road, restore stormwater conveyance.

actions.title: Erect Concrete Barrier & Evacuate Threatened Kiosks along Uwelu Rim
actions.description: Coordinate with Edo State Ministry of Physical Planning to mark 15-meter safety setback and barricade edge of gully.
actions.evidence_summary: Safety fence erected and 18 temporary structures cleared from gully rim.

actions.title: Finalize Geotechnical Tender Dossier for Uwelu Retaining Wall
actions.description: Prepare bill of quantities and engineering specifications for fast-track contractor procurement.

actions.title: Deploy Long-Boom Amphibious Excavator to Sakponba Canal
actions.description: Mobilize heavy swamp-buggy excavator to dredge primary blocked culvert section.
actions.evidence_summary: Swamp excavator mobilized and 45 truckloads of silt excavated.

actions.title: Install Warning Beacons & Divert Heavy Trucks on Ekpoma Escarpment Corridor
actions.description: Implement emergency traffic bypass for heavy articulated tankers to reduce vibrational load on slipping highway embankment in Esan West LGA.
actions.responsible_organization: Edo State Ecological Emergency Taskforce & FRSC Edo Sector Command
actions.evidence_summary: Warning signs posted, but heavy truck diversion awaiting joint enforcement with police.
